function.name: bstr_alloc_size
function.description: This function calculates the allocation size for a binary string (bstr) object.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the binary string to be allocated.

function.return_type: size_t, representing the allocation size for a binary string object.

function.name: bstr_from_str
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a bstr_t structure that contains the given BSTR string.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: This is the BSTR string that will be contained in the returned bstr_t structure.

function.return_type: bstr_t pointer, it represents a pointer to a bstr_t structure that contains the given BSTR string.

function.name: get_cache_entry_from_idx
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a cache entry based on the provided index. If the cache is not enabled or the index is out of range, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: cache_idx
parameters.description: This parameter represents the index of the cache entry to be retrieved.

function.return_type: bstr_cache_entry_t pointer, representing a pointer to a cache entry or NULL if the cache is not enabled or the index is out of range.

function.name: get_cache_entry
function.description: This function calculates the cache index based on the size and retrieves the cache entry from that index.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size used to calculate the cache index.

function.return_type: bstr_cache_entry_t pointer, represents the cache entry retrieved from the calculated index.

function.name: get_cache_entry_from_alloc_size
function.description: This function calculates the cache index based on the allocation size, and returns the cache entry corresponding to that index. If the allocation size is smaller than the bucket size, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: alloc_size
parameters.description: The size of the allocation for which a cache entry is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: bstr_cache_entry_t pointer, represents the cache entry corresponding to the calculated index. If the allocation size is smaller than the bucket size, it returns NULL.

function.name: alloc_bstr
function.description: This function allocates a binary string (bstr) of a given size. It first tries to get a cached entry of the required size. If no cached entry is available, it tries to get a larger cached entry. If still no cached entry is available, it allocates a new bstr using CoTaskMemAlloc. The size of the allocated bstr is then set to the requested size.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the binary string to be allocated

function.return_type: bstr_t pointer, representing the allocated binary string. If the allocation fails, it returns NULL.

function.name: SysStringLen
function.description: This function returns the length of a string.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: This parameter is the string whose length is to be calculated.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the length of the string.

function.name: SysStringByteLen
function.description: This function returns the size of a BSTR string in bytes.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: The BSTR string whose size is to be determined.

function.return_type: UINT representing the size of the string in bytes.

function.name: SysAllocString
function.description: This function allocates a new string and copies the input string into it. If the input string is null, it returns 0. The allocation and copying is delegated to the SysAllocStringLen32 method.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: This is the input string that will be copied into the newly allocated string.

function.return_type: BSTR, which represents the newly allocated string that contains the copied input string. If the input string is null, it returns 0.

function.name: get_malloc
function.description: This function returns a pointer to an IMalloc interface. If the pointer is not already initialized, it calls CoGetMalloc to initialize it.
function.return_type: IMalloc pointer, represents the interface to the memory allocator

function.name: SysFreeString
function.description: This function frees a string from memory, and handles the case where the string is already in cache. It also manages memory allocation and deallocation.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: The string to be freed from memory.

function.return_type: DECLSPEC_HOTPATCH, which is a macro used to specify that a function is a hotpatchable function. The function does not return a value.

function.name: SysAllocStringLen
function.description: This function allocates a new BSTR string that contains a specified number of characters from an input string and returns a pointer to this string. It also checks for integer overflow and returns NULL if an overflow is detected.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: This is the input string from which a specified number of characters will be copied.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: This specifies the number of characters to be copied from the input string.

function.return_type: BSTR, which represents a pointer to the newly allocated string. If an integer overflow is detected or memory allocation fails, the function returns NULL.

function.name: SysReAllocStringLen
function.description: This function reallocates a string to a new length. If the string is NULL, it allocates a new string. It also checks for integer overflow.

parameters.name: old
parameters.description: Pointer to the old string

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: Pointer to the new string

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The new length of the string

function.return_type: int, returns TRUE if successful, FALSE otherwise

function.name: SysAllocStringByteLen
function.description: This function allocates a new binary string with a specified length, copies the input string into it and returns a pointer to the new string. If the input string is NULL, it initializes the new string with zeros.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: This is the input string to be copied into the new binary string.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: This is the length of the new binary string to be allocated.

function.return_type: DECLSPEC_HOTPATCH. It represents a pointer to the new binary string. If the allocation fails or there is an integer overflow, it returns NULL.

function.name: SysReAllocString
function.description: This function reallocates a string by freeing the old string and allocating a new one.

parameters.name: old
parameters.description: Pointer to the old string to be reallocated

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: Pointer to the new string to be allocated

function.return_type: INT, returns 1 if the function executes successfully, and 0 if the old string pointer is NULL

function.name: SetOaNoCache
function.description: This function disables the bstr_cache.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: RegisterActiveObject
function.description: This function registers an active object by creating a moniker for the object and registering it in the running object table. It also handles the release of the moniker and the running object table.

parameters.name: punk
parameters.description: Pointer to the IUnknown interface of the object that is being registered.

parameters.name: rcid
parameters.description: Reference to the CLSID of the object.

parameters.name: dwFlags
parameters.description: Flags that control the registration.

parameters.name: pdwRegister
parameters.description: Pointer to the identifier of the active object registration.

function.return_type: DECLSPEC_HOTPATCH, represents the status of the function execution. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, it can return any error values from the underlying calls to CreateItemMoniker, GetRunningObjectTable, and IRunningObjectTable_Register.

function.name: RevokeActiveObject
function.description: This function revokes a previously registered active object from the running object table.

parameters.name: xregister
parameters.description: The identifier of the active object to revoke.

parameters.name: reserved
parameters.description: This parameter is reserved and should be NULL.

function.return_type: DECLSPEC_HOTPATCH. It represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value is a failure code.

function.name: GetActiveObject
function.description: This function retrieves a running object that has been registered with OLE and returns an interface pointer to that object. It does this by creating a moniker that identifies the object, getting the Running Object Table (ROT), and then getting the object from the ROT.

parameters.name: rcid
parameters.description: This is the CLSID of the active object the function is trying to get.

parameters.name: preserved
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface requested in riid. It is set to NULL if the function fails.

parameters.name: ppunk
parameters.description: This is the address of LPUNKNOWN pointer variable that receives the interface pointer to the running object. If the function fails, the reference is set to NULL.

function.return_type: DECLSPEC_HOTPATCH, which represents the success status of the function. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns a failure code.

function.name: OaBuildVersion
function.description: This function returns a version number based on the result of the GetVersion function masked with 0x8000ffff. It handles different cases for different Windows versions, and returns a long integer representing the version.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: ULONG, representing the version number of the Windows operating system.

function.name: OleTranslateColor
function.description: This function translates OLE color values to system color values.

parameters.name: clr
parameters.description: This is the OLE color value that needs to be translated.

parameters.name: hpal
parameters.description: This is the handle to the logical palette.

parameters.name: pColorRef
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the COLORREF variable that receives the translated color value.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: actctx_get_typelib_module
function.description: This function retrieves the module associated with a type library from the activation context.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: The interface identifier for the COM interface redirection.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: A pointer to a buffer that receives the module name.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The length of the module buffer.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully retrieves the module; otherwise, it returns FALSE.

function.name: reg_get_typelib_module
function.description: This function retrieves the module of a type library associated with a specified interface identifier (IID). It uses the Windows Registry to find the type library.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: The interface identifier for which the type library module is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: A pointer to a buffer that receives the module of the type library.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The length of the buffer pointed to by the module parameter.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value is E_FAIL.

function.name: get_typeinfo_for_iid
function.description: This function retrieves the type information for a given interface identifier (IID). It first tries to get the type library module from the activation context. If that fails, it tries to get it from the registry. It then loads the type library and gets the type information for the IID.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: The interface identifier for which to get the type information.

parameters.name: typeinfo
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an ITypeInfo interface. On successful return, it contains the requested type information.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds; otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: dispatch_typelib_ps_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches with the ID of IPSFactoryBuffer or IUnknown. If it matches, the function assigns the interface to the output pointer and returns S_OK. If it doesn't match, the function logs an error, assigns NULL to the output pointer, and returns E_NOINTERFACE.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IPSFactoryBuffer interface

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Interface ID to be checked

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Output pointer where the interface will be assigned if the interface ID matches

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface ID matches, E_NOINTERFACE otherwise

function.name: dispatch_typelib_ps_AddRef
function.description: This function returns a static value of 2.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of IPSFactoryBuffer.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents a static value of 2

function.name: dispatch_typelib_ps_Release
function.description: This function returns a static value of 1.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IPSFactoryBuffer object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents a static value of 1

function.name: dispatch_create_proxy
function.description: This function creates a proxy for a dispatch interface using a factory buffer.

parameters.name: outer
parameters.description: Pointer to the controlling IUnknown interface of the aggregate.

parameters.name: proxy
parameters.description: Address of IRpcProxyBuffer pointer variable that receives the interface pointer to the proxy.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Address of a pointer variable that receives the interface pointer to the proxy.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value can be one of the error values.

function.name: dispatch_typelib_ps_CreateProxy
function.description: This function creates a proxy for a specified interface or dispatches the creation of a proxy if the interface is IDispatch. It also handles the release of type information and attributes.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a proxy/stub factory.

parameters.name: outer
parameters.description: Pointer to the controlling IUnknown interface of the aggregate.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface for which the proxy is being created.

parameters.name: proxy
parameters.description: Address of IRpcProxyBuffer pointer variable that receives the interface pointer to the proxy.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Address of a pointer variable that receives the interface pointer to the proxy's implementation of the requested interface.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It returns the result of the proxy creation or the error code in case of failure.

function.name: dispatch_create_stub
function.description: This function creates a stub for a server object and releases the factory buffer.

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Pointer to the server object for which the stub is to be created

parameters.name: stub
parameters.description: Pointer to the stub buffer to be created

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, whether it was successful or not

function.name: impl_from_IRpcStubBuffer
function.description: This function retrieves the containing record for the given IRpcStubBuffer interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an IRpcStubBuffer interface.

function.return_type: struct dispinterface_stub, represents the containing record for the given IRpcStubBuffer interface pointer.

function.name: dispinterface_stub_Release
function.description: This function decreases the reference count of the stub. If the reference count reaches zero, it disconnects the stub buffer and frees the memory allocated to the stub.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface of the RPC stub buffer.

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the updated reference count after decrement.

function.name: find_idispatch_stub_vtbl
function.description: This function iterates over the oleaut32_oaidl_ProxyFileInfo.pStubVtblList until it finds the CInterfaceStubVtbl that matches the IID_IDispatch. If it doesn't find a match, it asserts a failure and returns NULL.
function.return_type: CInterfaceStubVtbl*. It represents a pointer to the found CInterfaceStubVtbl that matches the IID_IDispatch. If no match is found, it returns NULL.

function.name: dispinterface_create_stub
function.description: This function creates a stub for a dispinterface. It queries the server for the interface, initializes the stub vtable, and sets up the stub buffer.

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Pointer to the server object

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface identifier

parameters.name: stub
parameters.description: Pointer to the stub buffer

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and an error code if it fails

function.name: dispatch_typelib_ps_CreateStub
function.description: This function creates a stub for a type library. It first checks if the provided interface ID is equal to the ID of IDispatch. If it is, it creates a stub for the server. If not, it gets the type information for the interface ID. If it fails to get the type information, it returns the error. If it succeeds, it gets the type attributes. If it fails to get the type attributes, it releases the type information and returns the error. If it succeeds, it checks if the type kind is an interface or if the type flags indicate a dual interface. If either is true, it creates a stub from the type information. If not, it creates a stub for the dispinterface. If it fails to create a stub, it logs an error. Finally, it releases the type attributes and the type information, and returns the result.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the factory buffer

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Pointer to the server object

parameters.name: stub
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer of the RPC stub buffer

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function execution. It can indicate success or various types of errors

function.name: DllGetClassObject
function.description: This function is used to get the class object from a DLL module. It checks if the provided class and interface IDs match with predefined ones and accordingly returns the class object.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: The CLSID that will be compared with predefined CLSIDs

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: The IID that will be compared with predefined IIDs

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface pointer that receives the object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. S_OK if successful, error code otherwise

function.name: DllMain
function.description: This function is the entry point for a DLL. It is called by the system when processes and threads are initialized and terminated, or upon call to the LoadLibrary and FreeLibrary functions. It also checks if a specific environment variable is set.

parameters.name: hInstDll
parameters.description: A handle to the DLL module. The value is the base address of the DLL.

parameters.name: fdwReason
parameters.description: The reason the DLL entry-point function is being called. This parameter can be one of the following values: DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH, DLL_THREAD_ATTACH, DLL_THREAD_DETACH, DLL_PROCESS_DETACH.

parameters.name: lpvReserved
parameters.description: If fdwReason is DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH, lpvReserved is NULL for dynamic loads and non-NULL for static loads. If fdwReason is DLL_PROCESS_DETACH, lpvReserved is NULL if DllMain has been called by using FreeLibrary and non-NULL if DllMain has been called during process termination.

function.return_type: BOOL. If the function succeeds, the return value is nonzero. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: DllRegisterServer
function.description: This function calls the OLEAUTPS_DllRegisterServer function.
function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function call to OLEAUTPS_DllRegisterServer

function.name: DllUnregisterServer
function.description: This function unregisters a Component Object Model (COM) class from the Windows registry.
function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function call

function.name: OleIconToCursor
function.description: This function is partially implemented. It is intended to convert an HICON to an HCURSOR.

parameters.name: hinstExe
parameters.description: An instance handle to the executable file that contains the icon to be converted.

parameters.name: hIcon
parameters.description: A handle to the icon to be converted.

function.return_type: HCURSOR, a handle to the cursor. The function returns a copy of the icon as a cursor.

function.name: GetAltMonthNames
function.description: This function returns the alternative month names in Arabic, Polish, or Russian based on the provided locale identifier (LCID). If the LCID does not match any of these languages, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: This is a locale identifier that determines the language of the alternative month names to be returned.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to a wide string. The function sets this to point to the array of alternative month names, or to NULL if the LCID does not match Arabic, Polish, or Russian.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which indicates the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully.
